system.flavor:
Catch a tripwire before it springs, pull a friend off a pressure plate, kick a falling beam aside, or take the worst of a collapsing shelf for someone who did not see it. Whatever is set to go off, you take the teeth out of it.

Not enough to stop the trap entirely or to disarm it for good.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: A visible mundane trap or terrain hazard would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce that Damage by 2.

surges.html: Move the protected creature 1 unit to a safe adjacent space after the hazard resolves.
Suppress one ordinary Condition imposed by that hazard until the start of your next turn.
